name: quanti-sgtm-server-to-server
displayName: Quanti — move your server-side GTM to Quanti
description: Claude guides you step by step to move an existing server-side Google Tag Manager setup, hosted by another provider or by yourself, to a Quanti server on your own domain: your server container copied as is, every event tested before any visitor is switched, a switch in two reversible moves, then the data watched against the previous weeks.
